record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, to Jeduthun<WH03038>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Truly my soul<WH05315> waiteth<WH01747> upon God<WH0430>: from him <FI>cometh<Fi> my salvation<WH03444>. <RF>Truly: or, Only<Rf> <RF>waiteth: Heb. is silent<Rf>
He only <FI>is<Fi> my rock<WH06697> and my salvation<WH03444>; <FI>he is<Fi> my defence<WH04869>; I shall not be greatly<WH07227> moved<WH04131><WTH8735>. <RF>defence: Heb. high place<Rf>

How long will ye imagine mischief<WH02050><WTH8779> against a man<WH0376>? ye shall be slain<WH07523><WTH8792> all of you: as a bowing<WH05186><WTH8803> wall<WH07023> <FI>shall ye be, and as<Fi> a tottering<WH01760><WTH8803> fence<WH01447>.

They only consult<WH03289><WTH8804> to cast <FI>him<Fi> down<WH05080><WTH8687> from his excellency<WH07613>: they delight<WH07521><WTH8799> in lies<WH03577>: they bless<WH01288><WTH8762> with their mouth<WH06310>, but they curse<WH07043><WTH8762> inwardly<WH07130>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>inwardly: Heb. in their inward parts<Rf>
My soul<WH05315>, wait<WH01826><WTH8798> thou only upon God<WH0430>; for my expectation<WH08615> <FI>is<Fi> from him.
He only <FI>is<Fi> my rock<WH06697> and my salvation<WH03444>: <FI>he is<Fi> my defence<WH04869>; I shall not be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>.
In God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> my salvation<WH03468> and my glory<WH03519>: the rock<WH06697> of my strength<WH05797>, <FI>and<Fi> my refuge<WH04268>, <FI>is<Fi> in God<WH0430>.<CM>

Trust<WH0982><WTH8798> in him at all times<WH06256>; <FI>ye<Fi> people<WH05971>, pour out<WH08210><WTH8798> your heart<WH03824> before<WH06440> him: God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> a refuge<WH04268> for us. Selah<WH05542>.

Surely men<WH0120><WH01121> of low degree <FI>are<Fi> vanity<WH01892>, <FI>and<Fi> men<WH0376> of high degree <FI>are<Fi> a lie<WH03577>: to be laid<WH05927><WTH8800> in the balance<WH03976>, they <FI>are<Fi> altogether<WH03162> <FI>lighter<Fi>  than vanity<WH01892>. <RF>altogether: or, alike<Rf>

Trust<WH0982><WTH8799> not in oppression<WH06233>, and become not vain<WH01891><WTH8799> in robbery<WH01498>: if riches<WH02428> increase<WH05107><WTH8799>, set<WH07896><WTH8799> not your heart<WH03820> <FI>upon them<Fi> .

God<WH0430> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> once<WH0259>; twice<WH08147> have I heard<WH08085><WTH8804> this<WH02098>; that power<WH05797> <FI>belongeth<Fi> unto God<WH0430>. <RF>power: or, strength<Rf>
Also unto thee, O Lord<WH0136>, <FI>belongeth<Fi> mercy<WH02617>: for thou renderest<WH07999><WTH8762> to every man<WH0376> according to his work<WH04639>.<CM>
